description: Register a webhook endpoint. The response contains `secret` (whsec_...) ONCE: store it as COINVELLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Live endpoints must be HTTPS; test endpoints may be http://localhost. Use events ["*"] for everything or a list such as ["invoice.paid","invoice.expired"].

events.description: Event types or ["*"]. Common: invoice.paid, invoice.confirming, invoice.underpaid, invoice.overpaid, invoice.expired, payment.detected, checkout_session.completed.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks.

name: create_webhook
title: Create a webhook endpoint
